lines: Hi! They said you help when bad things come.
Hi! They said you make monsters go away.
You are the helper everyone talks about, right?
Hello! The grown-ups smile when they say your name.
Hi! Are you here to help again?
I heard you are brave. Are you tired from being brave?
People say the village is safer when you are nearby.
Hi! I am allowed to say hello to you.
They said you stood in front of danger. That sounds scary and cool.
<jump>Hi!</jump> I know you. You are the good kind of familiar.
The grown-ups smile when they see you coming.
People tell me you help when scary things happen.
I know your name from good stories.
The guards let you walk near the bell without watching.
Someone said you are almost part of the village.
I would ask you for help if I got lost.
People save you a place during celebrations.
The little kids try to wave first.
I am not supposed to bother you while you work.
The grown-ups trust you with important things.
